checks.name: five-routes-on-the-existing-auth-seam
checks.summary: The five routes are GET /v1/repositories (owner), POST /v1/repositories (owner), GET /v1/repositories/{repository_id} (owner), POST /v1/repositories/{repository_id}:retire (owner) and POST /v1/repositories/{repository_id}:observe (runner). They use the existing Authenticator/RoleOwner seam with no new authentication mechanism and no new header; :observe is gated on RoleRunner exactly the way /v1/runner/permits:check gates it at api.go L251-256, and the {id}:verb dispatch follows /v1/leases/{lease_id}:renew and /v1/executions/{execution_id}:start. Asserted for every one of the five: 401 without authentication, 403 for the wrong role, and the standard Error envelope carrying error, message, schema_version and correlation_id plus an X-Correlation-ID response header. Asserted 405 on DELETE /v1/repositories, PUT /v1/repositories/{id}, GET on {id}:retire and GET on {id}:observe. Asserted 415 on text/plain, on application/x-www-form-urlencoded and on an absent Content-Type. Asserted 400 on a malformed body, on an unknown field (DisallowUnknownFields) and on a locator that is not a repository coordinate. Asserted 409 on a duplicate normalised locator. Asserted 404 on an unknown repository id and on an unknown verb.

A Runner-submitted Observation moves the detail view's executability from unobserved to executable, and the rendered observation is asserted to carry no field whose name contains token, secret, credential, raw, stdout, stderr, output or header. Retire returns status retired, removes the row from the list, and leaves the detail readable with executability state retired. These three are separate tests with separate handlers on purpose: a bounded read transaction reserves quota.ReadTransactionUsage (6,001 reads) and the reservation fails closed at 80% of the daily budget, so four owner reads against one store exhaust it -- a real production property, recorded in the test's own comment.

checks.name: a10-six-declared-observables
checks.summary: A10, field by field, as rendered by GET /v1/repositories/{repository_id}. (1) 識別情報 -- MEASURED: repository_id (the loop-issued opaque identifier), locator {forge, host, owner, name, default_branch}, status, version and requested_by, all read from the stored aggregate in this request. (2) ApplicationのPreview/Stable状態 -- EXPLICITLY not-implemented, reason: 'no Application Release is bound to a Repository at this commit: the Preview and Stable release records exist only per Requirement (domain.StableReleaseSnapshot) and per release candidate, and no port associates either with a repository_id'. (3) 適用中の大原則とRepository固有ルール -- EXPLICITLY not-implemented, reason: 'no policy aggregate exists at this commit: neither the 大原則 set nor a Repository Contract / repository-specific rule record is persisted or exposed through any application port'. (4) Requirement Backlogの状態 -- repository scope EXPLICITLY unobserved, reason: 'no Requirement-to-Repository association exists at this commit, so no backlog can be scoped to this Repository' (dp-v2-064 d13 defers the association to the successor stage-2 task). The one thing that WAS measured, the Installation-wide queue counts from u.QueueSummary, is carried under the separate field name installation_scope, so a reader cannot mistake it for a repository-scoped figure. It is a real measurement reported at its real scope, not a substitute for the unmeasured one. (5) 利用可能なRunnerとAI資源 -- EXPLICITLY not-implemented, reason: 'no Runner registry and no Provider Account aggregate exist at this commit: RunnerObservationRepository is keyed by a single runner id with no enumeration port, and provider accounts and their AI resource limits are held only on the Runner machine'. (6) ループが実行可能かとその理由 -- MEASURED when a forge Observation exists, otherwise EXPLICITLY unobserved with the reason 'no forge reachability Observation has been submitted for this Repository yet; the Control Plane holds no forge client and never probes the forge itself'. When an Observation exists the state is derived from exactly three measured inputs and nothing else: the Repository's own status, the effective Control policy for it (also reported as effective_control_mode and effective_control_revision), and the Observation. States are the closed set executable / blocked / unobserved / retired, and Reason is always populated, including when executable is true. No field emits a plausible-looking value for anything that was not measured, and no value was invented, so A29's 'satisfying A10 would require inventing a value' escalation trigger did not fire.

checks.name: a13-control-plane-never-invokes-gh-or-git
checks.summary: Method: a go/ast scan (not a text grep) over every non-test *.go file under internal/api, internal/application, internal/domain, internal/store and cmd/control-plane. It rejects (a) any import of os/exec or of golang.org/x/sys, (b) any selector expression naming exec.Command, exec.CommandContext, exec.LookPath, os.StartProcess, syscall.Exec, syscall.ForkExec or syscall.StartProcess, and (c) any string literal whose whitespace/quote/pipe-separated words include exactly "gh" or exactly "git" -- import path literals excluded, because this module's own import prefix contains github.com and is not a command. Verdict: PASS with the logged measurement 'scanned non-test files=21 roots=[../api ../application ../domain ../store ../../cmd/control-plane]', and the scan fails outright if it sees fewer than 15 files, so it cannot pass by reading nothing. Deliberate narrowing recorded: a bare "syscall" import is NOT a finding, because cmd/control-plane/main.go L14/L136 legitimately imports it for signal.NotifyContext(os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM), which starts nothing; the process-starting syscall entry points are caught by selector instead. internal/runner is deliberately not in the scanned set: the forge adapter lives there precisely because that is the Runner. Note recorded without repair: internal/api has imported internal/runner since before this task (for the enrollment service), so internal/runner is linked into the control-plane binary; the assertion here is about the Control Plane's own source, and no Control Plane file constructs a ForgeClient.

checks.name: a27-cap-autonomous-resolution-is-not-closed
checks.summary: cap-autonomous-resolution is NOT closed by this task and cannot be. Its declaration is not narrowed, reinterpreted or annotated, and foundation-capabilities.json is not edited. Reason, read from the declaration itself: its user_action names 分解, 変更, 検証, 統合, Preview観測 and Stable反映, and its observable_result requires the Requirement detail to show Preview観測結果 and Stable反映状況. Preview観測 and Stable反映 depend on a Preview deploy, which is external-unavailable, so neither can be produced by any local work; inventing either would be exactly the fabrication the gate rules forbid. Beyond that, 変更 and 検証 both require a real Git working copy (a code change and a verification run inside it), which does not exist at this commit and is the successor stage-2 task's whole content, and 統合 requires an Integration Adapter emitting commit/branch/push, which is the successor stage-3 task's. This task removes the 'no implementation exists' condition for cap-repository-registration ONLY. cap-autonomous-resolution therefore does not close with V2-064 and its two successors together either, and none of the three may claim it (dp-v2-064 d12). A PR is explicitly not required by any reading: docs/policies/README.md L67, docs/architecture/overview.md L197, docs/principles.md L22 and docs/product/definition.md L297 each independently state it.
